subject.title: fix(clawhub): keep request deadline through response body

question: Should the existing ClawHub request timeout become a hard total lifetime for large archive downloads, or remain a header budget followed by progress-aware body handling?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes healthy slow-download behavior, and tests cannot decide whether a universal 30-second fail-closed contract is acceptable product policy.

options.title: Scope the total deadline
options.body: Apply the total budget to bounded JSON and error bodies, while large artifact bodies retain idle or progress-aware timeout handling.

options.title: Adopt a universal deadline
options.body: Make 30 seconds the documented total lifetime for every ClawHub response and add upgrade proof showing expected large downloads remain viable.

recommendation.title: Scope the total deadline
recommendation.body: Apply the total budget to bounded JSON and error bodies, while large artifact bodies retain idle or progress-aware timeout handling.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on ClawHub registry and artifact behavior makes this contributor the closest available history-based decision owner.
